description:
NOTICE OF APPLICATION FOR A PREMISES LICENCE :)

Notice is hereby given that Sample Bars Ltd, of 1 Demo Road, Sampleton SW1A 1AA, has applied to Westminster City Council for a premises licence under the Licensing Act 2003 in respect of Sample Venue, situated at 10 High Street, Sampleton SW1A 1AA.

The application is for the following licensable activities:
Sale of alcohol (on premises)

A full schedule of the proposed activities is as follows:
Sale of alcohol (on): Mon–Sun 00:00–23:59

Proposed operating hours:
{{OPERATING_HOURS}}

Designated Premises Supervisor (DPS):
Jane Doe

Any person wishing to make representations concerning this application should do so in writing to:

Westminster City Council
Licensing Team
Licensing Team, Civic Centre, Sampleton SW1A 2BB

Representations must be received by: 2025-12-17

The application may be inspected at:
Licensing Team, Civic Centre, Sampleton
{{INSPECTION_HOURS}}

Application submitted on: 2025-11-19
Dated: 2025-11-24

Westminster City Council
Licensing Authority
